description: Full-stack telemetry for Cloud Yatra, end to end: live service pulse, Cloudflare Worker + D1 backend health (metrics, logs, traces), browser real-user monitoring, game performance, gameplay analytics, and the shared leaderboard. Frontend via Faro; backend via Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo; database via Infinity.

title: Cloud Yatra · Grand Observatory

options.content:
Cloud Yatra · Live Observatoryक्लाउड यात्रा
Cloud Yatra is a browser game where you guide Yatri, a Nepali traveller, up from the jungle to the Himalayan summit. Every jump, fall and finish is recorded and shown here live. Play at cloud-yatra.pages.dev.

panels.title: PLAY THE GAME · everything you do here shows up in the charts below
Play Cloud Yatra here
panels.description: The live game. Play a run and watch the numbers below change.

panels.title: YOUR RUN · live stats for the game you are playing now
Your best score
panels.description: The highest score you reached in this session.

panels.title: Your progress
panels.description: How far up the mountain you have climbed, as a percentage.

panels.title: Summits reached
panels.description: How many times you finished the climb in this session.

panels.title: Falls
panels.description: How many times Yatri fell or was hurt in this session.

panels.title: Jumps
panels.description: How many jumps you made in this session.

panels.title: Flowers and bells
panels.description: Flowers and prayer bells you collected in this session.

Players online now

panels.title: Players so far
panels.description: Everyone who has ever started a climb.

panels.title: Game events per minute
panels.description: Actions (jumps, falls, pickups) the game reported in the last minute. Higher means more activity.

panels.title: Summits reached today
panels.description: How many times anyone finished the climb today (UTC).

panels.title: Lives lost today
panels.description: How many times players fell or were hurt today (UTC).

panels.title: Total game events recorded
panels.description: Every action ever recorded by the game, all time.

panels.title: IS THE SERVER HEALTHY? · speed, errors and reliability
Server requests per second
panels.description: How many requests the game server is handling each second.

panels.title: Game events saved per minute
panels.description: How many game actions the server stored in the last minute.

panels.title: Response time (slowest 5%)
panels.description: 95 out of 100 requests are answered faster than this. Green is under 150 ms, red is over 400 ms.

panels.title: Server error rate
panels.description: The share of requests where the server failed. Green means 0%, red means something is wrong.

panels.title: Uptime (availability)
panels.description: The share of requests that succeeded. The goal is 99% or more.

panels.title: Error allowance left
panels.description: The goal allows 1% of requests to fail. This shows how much of that allowance is still unused. 100% is perfect.

panels.title: Fast responses (under 0.5 s)
panels.description: The share of requests answered in under half a second. The goal is 95% or more.

panels.title: Error allowance burn rate (1 h)
panels.description: How fast the failure allowance is being used. 1 means exactly on pace, 0 means no errors, above 14 means an urgent problem.

How far players climb

panels.title: HOW THE GAME FEELS · speed and errors in players' browsers
Page load and response speed (slowest 5%)
panels.description: LCP: how long the game takes to appear. INP: how fast it reacts to a key press or tap. Lower is better. Measured in real players' browsers.

defaults.noValue: No activity in this time range. Play a run to fill it in.

targets.expr: max(quantile_over_time(0.95, {kind="measurement", app_id="2383"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_lcp .lcp }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval]))
max(quantile_over_time(0.95, {kind="measurement", app_id="2383"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_inp .inp }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval]))

panels.title: Visual stability and first load
panels.description: CLS: how much the page jumps around while loading (near 0 is best). TTFB: time until the server first answers. FCP: time until anything shows on screen.

defaults.noValue: No activity in this time range. Play a run to fill it in.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="2383"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_cls .cls }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval]))
avg(avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="2383"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_ttfb .ttfb }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval]))
avg(avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="2383"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_fcp .fcp }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval]))

panels.title: Game smoothness over time (FPS)
panels.description: Frames per second in players' browsers, split by region. 60 is perfectly smooth.

defaults.noValue: No activity in this time range. Play a run to fill it in.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="2383"} | logfmt | type="game_client_perf" | unwrap value_fps [$__interval]))

panels.title: How smooth is it for everyone? (FPS spread)
panels.description: Each column is a moment in time. Brighter cells mean more players were getting that frame rate.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="2383"} | logfmt | type="game_client_perf" | unwrap value_fps [$__interval])

defaults.noValue: No activity in this time range. Play a run to fill it in.
